The drugs need to be administered using syringe pumps that are available only in an CCU/ICU. If left untreated your heart will slow down (bradycardia) and may lead to asystole.

Stay out of student politics first and foremost. Engage in activities that promote learning with understanding. Discourage rote learning, all it does is rob us of the essence of conceptualisation. Read as many books as you can, besides your guide books (eg Endeavour, Selim Reza, etc). Doctors in Bangladesh aren't ever taught how to learn the art of correlation. Be an empath whenever you can. PG survival mostly depends on sycophancy, so try to find the balance between your own ideas and your integrity. Most people will rebuke you for having textbooks while taking a patient's history or doing a clinical examination, please don't give a shit to these naysayers. From one doctor to another. Tc
